heading: Principal office
lead: The principal office of the corporation shall be in the District of Columbia, or another place as determined by the board of directors. However, the corporation may conduct business throughout the States, territories, and possessions of the United States.

notes.text: Historical and Revision Notes RevisedSectionSource (U.S. Code)Source (Statutes at Large) 15170636:5703(a)(2), (3).Oct. 11, 1996, Pub. L. 104–285, title II, § 204(a)(2), (3), 110 Stat. 3384. This section is substituted for the source provisions for consistency in the revised title.
Amendments2005—Pub. L. 109–9 inserted “, or another place as determined by the board of directors” after “District of Columbia”.
